eventDetail.scope: The main theme of the conference is Digital & AI Technologies for Critical Infrastructures: Legacy, Sustainability, Autonomy, Transformation. Other themes are those at the core of the SSIT Technical Activities, namely: Ethics and Human Values in Technology; Gender Engagement and Social Inclusion (with specific initiatives related to promotion of women in engineering, and promotion of socio-economic diversity and science vulgarization); Sustainability; Access to Technology and Socio-Technical Systems.
